div.span: Key engine types and how they relate. Names follow crates/debrief-core/src; members are abridged. The store behind the Store ports is DuckDB (ADR 0014); Workspace is the in-memory test oracle. Condition / ConditionCfg are shared by extractors, markers, charts and pipeline steps.
